name: R I Welding & Fabricating Co
old_description: Established over 50 years ago, the R.I. Welding & Fabricating Company has been serving New England industries with a wide range of both semi and completely fabricated metals. We are well experienced in the fabrication of stainless and aluminum as well as mild steel. We also fabricate & install structural steel & miscellaneous metals including metal pan stairs, and miscellaneous and ornamental iron railings.
about:
R.I. Welding & Fabricating Co. operates from Providence, Rhode Island, where it has been serving New England industrial clients for more than five decades. The company was established over 50 years ago, though a precise founding year is not publicly documented, and no founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in available sources.

The shop specializes in the fabrication of stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel, producing both semi-finished and fully fabricated metal components. Its 16,000-square-foot facility is equipped with bridge cranes and monorail systems, complemented by a 30,000-square-foot enclosed yard. A workforce of 15 employees handles structural steel fabrication, metal pan stairs, and ornamental iron railings, with installation services offered on site. The company also operates its own delivery trucks and portable welders to support field work at customer plants or job sites.

The company serves a broad base of New England industries, with its product lineup pointing to construction, industrial maintenance, and architectural metalwork sectors. Typical projects include structural steel assemblies, stair systems, and decorative railings for commercial and industrial buildings.

R.I. Welding emphasizes its long regional tenure and the ability to deliver both shop-fabricated and field-installed metalwork from a single source, supported by in-house lifting equipment and mobile welding capability.
